summary.title: Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces
summary.one_liner: A free online operating systems textbook by Remzi and Andrea Arpaci-Dusseau that teaches OS concepts through virtualization, concurrency, and persistence.
takeaways: The book is organized around three conceptual pieces: virtualization, concurrency, and persistence.
It covers practical OS topics such as CPU scheduling, memory management, and persistent file storage.
The full book is free online in chapter form and as a PDF, and it has chapter homeworks that use simulators and code.
The page also links to project descriptions, errata, and a list of other OS and systems books.
summary.summary: This is the home page for Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces, a free online OS textbook by Remzi H. Arpaci-Dusseau and Andrea C. Arpaci-Dusseau of the University of Wisconsin-Madison, now at version 1.10 and with new security chapters by Peter Reiher (UCLA). The book is built around virtualization, concurrency, and persistence, and it explains practical topics such as CPU scheduling, memory management, and file storage. The page links to chapters, chapter homeworks that need simulators, project descriptions, and errata. It also lists other OS and systems books, plus fiction and non-fiction recommendations.
